question: Which bride-form great goddess protects as the syllable strīṃ?
premises: The syllable strīṃ is invoked as a protector.
The goddess has the form of a bride.
She is titled Deveśī and Maheśvarī.
inference: The strīṃ-syllable, as the bride-form Maheśvarī, grants protection.
plain_english: May the syllable strīṃ, the bride-form goddess-lord Maheśvarī, protect me.
